title: The Inventory list's available quantity still leaves out a negative bin
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a tracked part, part A, for this test at a cost of $10.00, with 5 in bin location A and 0 in bin location B, so the report has two bins to add up.
  • Add 2 of part A to a work order line from bin location B while it holds 0, so bin location B goes to -2.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click Reports in the top bar.
  3. Click Inventory Value.
  4. Pick the test location only in the Location filter.
  5. Type part A's part number in the report's Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's Total Qty reads "5 Available", the positive bin only: the -2 in bin location B is not taken off what can be picked.

Step 2:

  • The Reports page opens.

Step 3:

  • The Inventory Value report opens.

Step 4:

  • The report shows the test location only.

Step 5:

  • The Inventory Value report, by contrast, shows Qty 3.00 for part A (5 + (-2)): only the report moved to the net figure.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
